name: effort-pilot
description: The right reasoning effort for every turn: plans xhigh, building medium, questions low, picked by a Haiku classifier. The model is never changed and the prompt cache is kept: where effort is a whole-request setting (Claude 4.x, Fable 5, Bedrock, Vertex), it stands aside.

planEffort.title: Plan effort
planEffort.description: Effort for plans and plan mode.

analyzeEffort.title: Analyze effort
analyzeEffort.description: Effort for hard questions and investigations, with nothing to build.

buildEffort.title: Build effort
buildEffort.description: Effort for building and fixing, and for carrying out an approved plan. Subagents never go below it.

hardBuildEffort.title: Hard build effort
hardBuildEffort.description: Effort for building or fixing that is hard: many files, tricky logic, a bug of unknown cause.

talkEffort.title: Talk effort
talkEffort.description: Effort for questions, chat, status and tiny edits.

managedModels.title: Managed models
managedModels.description: Comma-separated words; a model whose name holds one of them (case-insensitive) gets its effort set. Others are left alone.

agents.title: Steered agents
agents.description: Comma-separated names of your own or plugin agents to set by their brief like built-in subagents, over the effort their own definition sets: reviewer, lab:builder, lab:* (a plugin's every agent) or * (every agent that is not a built-in). An effort the Agent call names, or CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_EFFORT, still wins. Empty: built-ins only.

sessionAgent.title: Session agent
sessionAgent.description: With headless on: the agent a claude -p --agent <type> session runs as, where Claude Code does not say it. Its first prompt is read as that agent's brief (at least the build effort), and its turns are recorded with the agent's type. Empty: Claude Code's word.

headless.title: Steer headless runs
headless.description: Also set the effort in claude -p and Agent SDK runs. Off: only interactive sessions.

measure.title: Measure
measure.description: Leave a share of turns at your own effort (control turns) and record every turn, so /effort-pilot report can compare cost, speed and quality against high. Off: the plugin only sets the effort.

controlShare.title: Control share (%)
controlShare.description: While measuring: the percent of eligible turns left at high, 0 to 100.
